response.sql: WITH major_groups AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), shares AS (SELECT member_count, member_count * 1.0 / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_groups), compared AS (SELECT member_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share_across_groups FROM shares) SELECT SUM(member_count) AS total_members, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share_across_groups) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE share > average_share_across_groups;
